result.title: Dually Constrained Parameter Projection for Continual Learning
result.summary: Continual learning requires a model to learn multiple new tasks sequentially while retaining performance on previous tasks. Projecting model parameters onto the Jacobian null space of previous tasks after unconstrained training on a new task has emerged as an effective paradigm. However, unidirectional projection merely minimizes the parameter distance to the new-task optimum, overlooking the new-task loss landscape. To address this limitation, we propose DUET, a bidirectional projection algorithm that imposes Jacobian null-space constraints from both previous and new tasks during post-training projection. Specifically, DUET formulates the post-training adjustment as a dually constrained optimization problem. It minimizes the distance between parameters before and after training on a new task, subject to loss preserving constraints on both tasks. To solve the optimization problem, we develop an alternating bidirectional projection algorithm, whose convergence is guaranteed by the contraction mapping theorem. For reliable multi-step projection, we rectify existing step size selection criteria via an effective-rank aware formulation, overcoming their failure under rank-deficient Jacobians. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUET consistently outperforms existing unidirectional projection methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 DUET，将新任务训练后的参数调整表述为双向约束优化问题，同时施加旧任务与新任务的 Jacobian 零空间约束，并给出交替投影算法与秩感知步长准则，用于持续学习中的灾难性遗忘缓解。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其零空间投影式的「保留旧行为同时学习新任务」约束，或可借鉴到 LVR/VLM 微调中抑制视觉信息坍缩与能力干扰的训练监督设计，值得核查其可行性与代价。
